subject.title: feat(macos): visible-markdown copy, full-message reader, and independent reasoning/tool toggles

question: After the reader parity defect and real-behavior proof are resolved, should the compatibility-sensitive public chat API and UserDefaults migration land in this release?
rationale: The PR changes shared public protocol/view surface and user-persisted display preferences, so maintainers must explicitly accept the upgrade contract rather than infer it from green checks.

options.title: Land with compatibility proof
options.body: Approve after the reader preserves enabled trace content and the author shows fresh-install and migrated-preference behavior with real macOS evidence.

options.title: Narrow the shared API
options.body: Keep the macOS feature but redesign the shared transport/display additions if maintainers do not want this public compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Land with compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Approve after the reader preserves enabled trace content and the author shows fresh-install and migrated-preference behavior with real macOS evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation and can clarify the intended shared-chat and macOS behavior while a repository owner makes the final compatibility decision.
